latestVersion.changelog: docs-refresh is a portable documentation-refresh workflow packaged in a reusable prompt/skill layout. It treats the repository as the record system, starts from AGENTS.md as a map, inspects current workspace state, and uses progressive disclosure to load only the workflow branch that matches the repository's current docs maturity and foundation maturity.
